# Exceptions for scan.py. One per line:
#   text <regex>   ignore a hit when this regex matches the hit and up to 40
#                  characters around it
#   path <glob>    skip a file entirely (keep these few and specific)
# Keep entries to placeholders and public data; never add a real private value.

# Placeholder hostnames in ikam's own tests and README.
text (?i)\bmac(?:\.(?:example|tail1234))?\.ts\.net\b
# A LibreOffice version number in fixture notes, not an address.
text LibreOffice \d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+
# Example paths in the vendored upstream skills (public text, not this machine).
text /Users/jesse/
